events.title: Geareo Early Access Launch Date Revealed!
events.summary: We’re excited to announce that Geareo will launch into Early Access on December 10, 2026!Our announcement trailer is here, marking the next big milestone in Geareo’s development.Build machines, connect circuits, experiment with physics, and bring your engineering ideas to life. From complex mechanical systems to completely unexpected creations, we can’t wait to see what you’ll build.We couldn’t have made it this far without your support, feedback, and incredible creations. events.title: Steampunk Update
events.summary: Steampunk and Pneumatics Are Here!Update 0.8.0The Steampunk Update brings pneumatic simulation to the demo! Build steam-powered systems with pressure, pipes, pistons, valves, and more.What's new:Steampunk UpdatePneumatic simulationBoiler part for generating and storing pressurePipe part for connecting steam bodiesPiston part for converting pressure differences into physical forceGauge part for monitoring pressureValve part for controlling steam flowRegulator part for limiting maximum pressureFix

events.title: Steam Workshop Now Available in the Demo!
events.summary: Update 0.7.0The biggest addition is Steam Workshop support for the demo. You can now upload your creations, browse community creations, and download them directly through Steam Workshop.What's new in 0.7.0:Steam Workshop supportPart Existence modes and Ghost BodiesSmaller Logic part sizesLabel selection and renaming in CircuitsIncreased Stone material frictionHave fun creating and sharing your builds!
